name: Bellinis
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bellinis in Innsbruck**

Discover the charm of **Innsbruck**, the vibrant capital of **Tirol**, where alpine beauty meets urban flair. Sip on a refreshing **Bellini**—a classic cocktail of peach purée and prosecco—while soaking in the city’s stunning backdrop of the **Nordkette** mountains.

From historic old town squares to modern cafés, **Innsbruck** offers the perfect blend of culture and relaxation. Whether you’re exploring the **Goldenes Dachl** or strolling along the **Inn River**, every moment feels like a postcard.

Indulge in local flavors too—pair your **Bellini** with a slice of **Kaiserschmarrn** or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** for the ultimate alpine experience.

Plan your escape to **Tirol** today!
